performance_panel.mixed_batch: Four distinct targets; B1 versus B4 full valid logits/embedding numerical diagnostics

fitness_protocol.scoring: WT single-position masked marginals; sum mutant minus WT logits; additive for multi mutants
fitness_protocol.sequence_context: Full pinned assay target sequence, no MSA and no structure; no label fitting
fitness_protocol.batch_validation: First, middle and last mutated positions; B1 vs B8 full 64 logits
fitness_protocol.quality_threshold_note: Observe quality, never invent a post-hoc accuracy acceptance threshold. Engineering PASS validates execution/data/scoring checks.

limitations: Bounded panel and three full assays, not the full ProteinGym leaderboard
Additive multi-mutant scoring does not model joint epistasis
OpenFold structure standard dataset remains separate
